buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC) – Supply of 1.Condiments Scope of supply. The bidder shall quote for the items, pack sizes, units a nd quantities specified in Annexure A. Items listed as PKT shall be quoted per packet of the specified size. Items listed as KGS shall be quoted per kilogram. 2. Price schedule. The bidder shall quote GST-inclusive unit rates in the prescribed price schedule. The rates shall include packing, transport and unloading. The applicable GST rate shall be shown separately where required by the bid format. 3. Technical compliance. The bidder shall state the brand or manufacturer, pack size an

d relevant product specifications for each item quoted and submit the supporting documen ts specified in the bid. A bid that fails to meet a published mandatory technical requirement shall be rejected at the technical evaluation stage. 4. Food safety, packaging and labelling. The bidder shall provide applicable FSSAI lice nce or registration details. Goods shall be supplied in intact, sealed, food-grade packaging. Where applicable, labels shall show the product name, net quantity, batch or lot number, a nd required date markings. Goods shall be within their declared shelf life at delivery. 5. Sample submission and approval. Where Annexure A specifies a sample requirement , the successful bidder shall submit a sealed sample of the offered product for written appr oval before bulk supply. The buyer shall assess the sample against the published item speci fications, including pack size, packaging integrity and applicable labelling requirements. If t he sample fails to comply, the supplier shall submit a conforming replacement within the pe riod specified in the contract. Failure to obtain approval may result in cancellation in accord ance with the contract terms. 6. Delivery and documentation. The supplier shall deliver the goods in accordance with the purchase order and the delivery schedule stated in the bid. Each consignment shall be accompanied by an itemised delivery challan showing the items, pack sizes, units and qua ntities supplied. 7. Inspection and acceptance. The buyer shall verify the quantities, pack sizes, packagi ng condition, labels and conformity with Annexure A upon receipt. Where sample approval applies, the bulk supply shall also conform to the approved sample. The supplier shall repla ce rejected goods and make good any shortages at its own cost within the period specified in the contract. 8. Invoicing and payment. The supplier shall submit an itemised invoice referencing the purchase order and delivery challan. The invoice shall show the quantities, contracted unit rates and applicable GST. Payment shall be based on the quantities accepted by the buyer at the contracted rates and shall follow the payment terms stated in the bid. 9. Bid evaluation. The buyer shall apply the same published technical requirements and evaluation criteria to all bidders. Financial evaluation of technically compliant bids shall foll ow the item-wise or total-price basis stated in the bid schedule. .
